name: Prosper
long_description:
Prosper builds AI phone agents for healthcare providers. Our agents automate manual, time-intensive workflows like patient scheduling, balance reminders, claims status checks, benefit verification, and prior authorizations. We integrate with 80+ EHRs, go live in 3 weeks, and offer a no-code interface for customization.

Today, Prosper handles thousands of daily calls for dozens of providers, reducing costs by 50% and tripling productivity. We’re building the AI-first operating system for healthcare to eliminate the $200B lost to administrative overhead every year.
one_liner: AI Phone Agents for Healthcare Operations

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder of Prosper, building AI agents to fix healthcare's $200B admin burden. Previously VP/GM of a $120M business unit, leading 800+ customer service agents, 300 phone sales reps, and 30+ ops staff. Advised healthcare PE and tech companies on GTM and operations at Bain & Co. MBA from Harvard, BBA from ESADE.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder of Prosper,  building AI agents to fix healthcare's $200B admin burden. Previously Product leader at Coverwallet (acq. by Aon), where I led the Insurance Health initiative that drove the acquisition, scaling the team from 3 PMs to 40+ and 200+ engineers. Co-founder of Arcvi, an AI consulting firm across Insurance, Health and Banking - top 2% in the Data Science Bowl for lung cancer image prediction. Former MIT Computer Vision research assistant.
